items.title: Consumer inflation eases to 10.3pc in September from 11.1pc in August, official data shows
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: Consumer inflation eased to 10.3 per cent in September from 11.1pc a month earlier, mainly due to a sharp slowdown in food inflation, the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
The slight deceleration in the inflation rate, measured by the Consumer Price Index, reversed the sharp increase recorded in August, when higher food and energy prices pushed the annual rate to 11.1pc from 9.2pc in July.
The easing was more pronounced in rural areas, where inflation fell to 10.5pc from 12.2pc, while urban inflation edged down to 10.1pc from 10.4pc.

items.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon AI model after months of delays, restricts access over safety concerns
items.description:
Alphabet’s Google on Wednesday announced a new top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) model, “Argon”, to anchor its Gemini 4 generation of models in a fresh bid to catch up to rivals Anthropic and OpenAI in the AI race.
However, Google said it would withhold the model from the public for now, releasing Gemini 4 Argon only to a vetted group of cybersecurity experts to avoid misuse by hackers.
“Safely releasing frontier capabilities at this level requires a phased approach,” wrote Koray Kavukcuoglu, Google’s chief AI architect, in a blog post announcing the model.

items.title: Security forces kill 6 terrorists in IBO in Balochistan's Kachhi: security sources
items.description:
Security forces killed six terrorists in an intelligence-based operation (IBO) in Balochistan’s Kachhi district, security sources said on Thursday, according to state-run Radio Pakistan.
According to security sources, terrorists affiliated with Fitna al Hindustan were successfully targeted using quadcopters in Kachhi’s Sanni area.
The state refers to designated Balochistan-based groups as Fitna al Hindustan to highlight India’s role in terrorism and destabilisation across Pakistan.
Radio Pakistan reported that a large quantity of arms and ammunition was recovered from the terrorists.

items.description:

The result builds on Wednesday’s quarter-final win over South Korea, which had already secured Pakistan a third overall Asian Games squash team medal.
